public_definitions: The task is to assess the emergency department utilization dashboard and assign the record to the follow-up pathway that best fits the overall utilization pattern over the review period.
The dashboard is the evidence source for selecting the appropriate emergency department utilization follow-up pathway.

The three options are: 'Route the emergency department visit record to utilization-growth follow-up', 'Route the emergency department visit record to utilization-decrease follow-up', and 'Route the emergency department visit record to standard trend monitoring'.
